details.decision_rationale: The confirmed mortality match and facial match score below the recommended threshold suggest potential identity fraud, triggering a high risk rating. Enhanced Due Diligence is not required for this case, as the risk score and other factors do not necessitate it. The combination of these risk signals and compliance findings supports the recommendation to reject the case.
final_recommendations: Reject the case due to confirmed mortality match
Implement Article 22C safeguards to ensure GDPR compliance
